MELLENADE — full site redesign

Concept: lean into the lemonade-stand DNA already in the logo and in "The Mellenade Stand". Citrus + navy, so it does not look like every other dark hobby shop.

Fixed from the audit: brand green is now #20883d (was #28ab4d at 2.99:1, failing WCAG AA). Header gains the two things it was missing — search and a cart.

Search is the primary nav for a card store — people arrive knowing a player, set or year. Cart badge is always visible.

Sell Your Collection promoted from a small text link to a real button, and it keeps 44px+ touch targets on mobile.

All prices, counts, team names and phone number are bracketed placeholders — nothing here is invented as fact. Product titles are realistic category examples to show the layout; swap them for real inventory.

Product photos are marked frames, as is each brand logo (Topps / Panini / Upper Deck / Pokémon) — drop your existing image files into those slots.
